purpose: exploratory baseline, not a driving or perception quality acceptance
augmentation: train only: independent brightness and contrast uniform [0.8,1.2], no spatial resize or flip
class_weights: train pixels only: inverse square root frequency, divide by minimum, clamp [1,20]
selection: maximum validation macro IoU over supported focus classes 1..7; earliest epoch wins ties
test_policy: evaluate selected checkpoint once after all epochs; never select or tune on test
